issues.detail: The Greek text 'ειναι' (is) is part of the reported speech, but the Vietnamese translation misses the finality of the statement. More importantly, the Greek 'πως λεγουσιν' implies 'how/that they say', whereas the Vietnamese 'Sao người ta nói' (Why do people say) introduces a question of 'why' which is not present in the Greek text.
